title.ja: 図1-1 ゴキゲン中飛車の基本図
title.en: Figure 1-1: Basic diagram of Gokigen Central Rook

explain.ja: 図1-1はゴキゲン中飛車の基本図です。ここから超速3七銀との戦い方を見ていきます。ゴキゲン中飛車は基本的に後手番で使う戦法なので盤面を反転しています。基本図までの指し手は別の記事で解説しています。
explain.en: The first diagram is the basic Gokigen Central Rook position. From here we look at how to fight the Chosoku 3七 Silver. The board is flipped because Gokigen Central Rook is normally played as White. The moves up to the basic position are covered in another article.

section.ja: ゴキゲン中飛車の基本図
section.en: Basic diagram of Gokigen Central Rook

title.en: Figure 1-2: What is the opponent aiming for...?

explain.ja: 基本図から相手は▲3六歩と突きました。何気ない一手ですが、「超速3七銀」の合図です。ゴキゲン中飛車側はここで指しておきたい手があります。
explain.en: From the basic position the opponent played ▲3六歩. It looks innocent, but it is the signal for the Chosoku 3七 Silver. The Central Rook side has a move to play right here.

section.ja: 素早く銀を上げ、銀対抗に
section.en: Raise the silver quickly for a silver confrontation

title.ja: 図1-3 銀対抗に構える
title.en: Figure 1-3: Set up against the silver

explain.ja: 相手の▲3六歩は、次に△3七銀と素早く銀を使うのが狙いです。こちらも相手の銀の進出に合わせ、△4二銀~△4四銀と銀を出しましょう。図1-3の形は銀対抗と呼ばれ、互いの銀が向かい合います。銀を出すタイミングが1手遅れると、次に▲4五銀から角頭の歩を狙われます。あえて銀を出さない指し方もありますが、初心者には難しい変化も多いので、今回は銀対抗で駒組みする順を見ます。
explain.en: Black's ▲3六歩 aims to bring the silver out quickly to 3七 next. Match it by advancing your own silver with △4二銀 and then △4四銀. The shape in diagram 1-3 is called Silver Confrontation (ginntaiko), with the two silvers facing each other. If you are one move late bringing the silver out, ▲4五銀 follows and targets the pawn in front of your bishop. There are also lines that deliberately do not advance the silver, but they contain many difficult variations for beginners, so here we follow the Silver Confrontation setup.

section.ja: 素早く銀を上げ、銀対抗に
section.en: Raise the silver quickly for a silver confrontation

title.ja: 図1-4 ひとまず囲いを目指す
title.en: Figure 1-4: For now, aim for a castle

explain.ja: 銀対抗に構えたら、落ち着いて囲いを組みます。美濃囲いを目指しつつ、相手の出方によっては反撃を狙います。攻めの陣形ができたら、一呼吸おいて美濃囲いを組むわけです。
explain.en: Once you have set up the Silver Confrontation, calmly build your castle. Aim for the Mino castle while looking for a counterattack depending on how the opponent plays. After the attacking formation is ready, take a breath and build the Mino castle.

section.ja: 美濃囲いを目指していく

title.ja: 図2-1 角頭を狙われたら？
title.en: Figure 2-1: What if the bishop's head is targeted?

explain.ja: 相手が舟囲いのまま急戦を仕掛けてきた場合を見ます。飛車を3筋に振って▲3五歩から攻めてきました。ここで素直に△同歩と取ってよいのでしょうか。
explain.en: Now consider the case where the opponent starts a fast attack while still in a Funa-gakoi castle. They swing the rook to the third file and attack with ▲3五歩. Is it fine to simply capture with △同歩 here?

section.en: What if the bishop's head is attacked?

title.ja: 図2-2 相手の攻めが好調にも見えるが…？
title.en: Figure 2-2: The opponent's attack looks good, but...?

explain.ja: 図2-1からは、自然に△同歩と取って銀交換になって問題ありません。図2-2では相手が気持ちよく攻めている局面にも見えますが、ここでゴキゲン中飛車の捌きの手筋があります。
explain.en: From this position it is fine to capture naturally with △同歩 and go into the silver exchange. The next position may look as if the opponent is attacking comfortably, but Gokigen Central Rook has a tesuji to untangle things here.

title.en: Figure 2-3: △4四角 is the sabaki tesuji

explain.ja: △4四角が捌きの手筋です。ここから少し進めると、ゴキゲン中飛車が指しやすい展開になります。通常の振り飛車では4四に歩があることが多くこの手筋は使えないため、ゴキゲン中飛車特有の手順です。
explain.en: △4四角 is the tesuji that frees your position. If you play on a little from here, the game becomes easier for the Central Rook side. In ordinary Ranging Rook openings there is usually a pawn on 4四, so this tesuji is unavailable; it is specific to Gokigen Central Rook.

title.ja: 図2-4 飛車をぶつけて交換を狙う
title.en: Figure 2-4: Clash the rooks to aim for an exchange

explain.ja: こちらも飛車を3筋に振って飛車交換を狙います。飛車を交換して攻め合いになれば、囲いが堅いゴキゲン中飛車のほうが指しやすくなります。
explain.en: You also swing your rook to the third file and aim for a rook exchange. If rooks are exchanged and it becomes a mutual attack, the Central Rook side, with its firmer castle, has the easier game.

title.ja: 図2-5 どうやって桂取りを受ける？
title.en: Figure 2-5: How to defend against the knight threat?

explain.ja: 相手が飛車交換に応じ、▲4一飛と打ってきた局面です。桂取りに当たっていますが、ここにいい受けがあります。振り飛車党ならぜひ覚えておきたい手筋です。
explain.en: The opponent has accepted the rook exchange and dropped a rook with ▲4一飛. It attacks the knight, but there is a good defense. Ranging Rook players should definitely remember this tesuji.

section.ja: 美濃囲いを固める自陣飛車
section.en: Rook in own camp to solidify the Mino castle

title.ja: 図2-6 自陣飛車が手筋
title.en: Figure 2-6: Rook in own camp is the tesuji

explain.ja: △3一飛と自陣飛車を打つのが手筋です。相手は▲同飛と取るしかなく、△同金と進めば、こちらの陣地に飛車を打たれる隙がなくなります。ここで△3一歩と底歩を打つのもよい手です。
explain.en: Dropping a rook in your own camp with △3一飛 is the tesuji. The opponent has no choice but to capture with ▲同飛, and after △同金 there is no longer any weakness in your camp for a rook drop. Dropping a pawn on the bottom rank with △3一歩 is also a good alternative here.

section.ja: 美濃囲いを固める自陣飛車
section.en: Rook in own camp to solidify the Mino castle

title.ja: 図3-1 相手は囲いを固めてきた
title.en: Figure 3-1: The opponent has fortified the castle

explain.ja: 図1-4まで戻り、別の変化を見ます。今度は相手が角道を閉じて囲いを固めてきました。相手の陣形が整う前に攻めたいところですが、5筋からの攻めは難しそうです。
explain.en: Go back to diagram 1-4 and look at another variation. This time the opponent closes the bishop line and firms up their castle. You would like to attack before their formation is complete, but an attack on the fifth file looks difficult.

section.ja: 相手は角道を閉じて持久戦に
section.en: The opponent closes the bishop diagonal and plays a long game

line.text: ▲6六歩、△8二玉、▲6七金、△7二銀、▲7七角、△9四歩、▲9六歩

title.ja: 図3-2 相手の弱い筋に振りなおす
title.en: Figure 3-2: Re-swing to the opponent's weak file

explain.ja: 5筋からの攻めが難しいと感じたら、中飛車にこだわらず別の筋に振り直しましょう。ここでは三間飛車に振り直し、3筋からの攻めを狙います。
explain.en: If an attack on the fifth file seems hard, do not cling to Central Rook; re-swing the rook to another file. Here we move to Third-file Rook (Sanken Rook) and aim to attack on the third file.

section.ja: 相手の弱い筋に振りなおす
section.en: Switch the rook to the opponent's weak file

title.ja: 図3-3 角を引いて飛車の道を通す
title.en: Figure 3-3: Retreat the bishop to open the rook's path

explain.ja: △4二角と引いて飛車のラインを通します。次の狙いは△3五歩から3筋を攻めることです。△2二角と引いてしまうと▲2四歩から攻められるので注意が必要です。
explain.en: Retreat the bishop with △4二角 to open the rook's line. The next aim is to attack on the third file starting with △3五歩. Be careful: retreating with △2二角 would allow an attack starting with ▲2四歩.

section.ja: 相手の弱い筋に振りなおす
section.en: Switch the rook to the opponent's weak file

title.ja: 図3-4 相手も飛車を振って受けてきた
title.en: Figure 3-4: The opponent also swung the rook to defend

explain.ja: 今度は相手も飛車を振って、3筋からの攻めを受けてきました。ここからどう攻めればよいでしょうか。
explain.en: This time the opponent has also swung their rook to meet the attack on the third file. How should you attack from here?

section.ja: 三間飛車から向かい飛車へ
section.en: From Third File Rook to Ranging Rook on the opposite side

title.ja: 図3-5 今度は向かい飛車に振りなおす
title.en: Figure 3-5: This time re-swing to Opposing Rook

explain.ja: 相手の2筋の守りが薄くなったので、向かい飛車に振り直して2筋から攻めます。相手も飛車を戻して守ってきましたが、構わず△2四歩から攻めていきます。
explain.en: The opponent's second file has become thin, so re-swing to Opposing Rook (Mukai Rook) and attack on the second file. The opponent returns their rook to defend, but you press on regardless, attacking with △2四歩.

section.ja: 三間飛車から向かい飛車へ
section.en: From Third File Rook to Ranging Rook on the opposite side

title.ja: 図3-6 飛車が捌けた局面
title.en: Figure 3-6: Position where the rook is freed

explain.ja: 図3-5の局面で飛車交換ができました。相手はまだ囲いが完成していないので、互いに飛車で攻め合う展開になれば、ゴキゲン中飛車側がやや指しやすいと言えます。相手の陣形に合わせて飛車を次々に振り直していく感覚を身につけましょう。
explain.en: From Diagram 3-5 the rooks could be traded. Since the opponent has not finished the castle yet, if the game becomes a rook-versus-rook attacking race, the Gokigen Central Rook side is slightly better off. Get a feel for re-ranging your rook again and again according to the opponent's formation.

section.ja: 三間飛車から向かい飛車へ
section.en: From Third File Rook to Ranging Rook on the opposite side

title.ja: 図4-1 超速2枚銀の構え

explain.ja: 図1-4から、先手が左の銀も前に出してくる作戦があります。図4-1は「超速2枚銀」と呼ばれる構えで、ゴキゲン中飛車側が飛車を5筋から動かすと、すぐに▲5五銀と5筋の歩を取れる形です。この2枚銀の形からは難解な変化が続き、簡単には進みません。
explain.en: From Diagram 1-4, Black can also bring out the left silver. Diagram 4-1 is called the Super-Fast Double Silver setup: if the Gokigen Central Rook side moves the rook off the 5th file, Black can immediately take the 5th-file pawn with ▲5五銀. Complicated variations follow from this double-silver formation, so it is not easy to handle.
